---
title: Downloading the view
---

`download` adds a button that saves the current view (filtered, sorted, across all pages) as a CSV or RTF file, picked from a menu. Try filtering first.

```{r}
library(lt)
d = mtcars[, c("mpg", "cyl", "hp", "wt", "gear")]
lt(d) |> lt_interactive(download = "cars.csv", pager = 5)
```
